main_result: Theorem 3.3 bounds the dyadic integer-modulus average of the maximum over unit numerators of the inverse-prime sum by a constant times (Q^(13/10)x^(3/5)+Q^(13/12)x^(5/6))Q^epsilon uniformly for 1≤x≤Q^(3/2).
read_scope: Targeted check of the dyadic inverse-prime phase, integer modulus, unit numerator, and the averaged upper bound and length range. Full PDF retained privately.
result_status: Exact source statement checked at targeted passages. The local power-saving region depends on the independently reviewed weight and modulus accounting.
selection_reason: Direct source bound for the longer prime window, including some P>K, and reduced-modulus blocks in the general smooth C-star prime-stratum estimate.
source_locator: §3.1, printed p. 296/PDF p. 12, inverse-prime sum definition; §3.5, printed p. 301/PDF p. 17, Theorem 3.3
title: On a ternary quadratic form over primes
transfer_hypothesis: Use reduced unit numerators on each reduced modulus block and common prime endpoints in Abel summation. Check 1≤x≤Q^(3/2) for the applicable blocks, using a separate bound for smaller moduli.
version: 2011 Acta Arithmetica publisher PDF, vol. 150 no. 3, pp. 285–314
